name: PasteDataTableToExcelWorksheetNode
label: Paste DataTable to Excel Worksheet
description: Pastes the contents of a DataTable into the specified Excel worksheet at a given location.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: WorksheetInstance
fields.label: Worksheet Instance
fields.description: The Excel Worksheet where the DataTable will be pasted.

fields.name: DataTableInput
fields.label: Data Table
fields.description: The DataTable containing the data to paste.

fields.name: StartColumn
fields.label: Start Column
fields.description: The starting column where data will be pasted (letter or number).

fields.name: StartRow
fields.label: Start Row
fields.description: The starting row where data will be pasted.

fields.name: IncludeHeaders
fields.label: Include Headers
fields.description: Whether to include the DataTable column headers in the output.
